lifecycle.retention: Retain editable logical subject and pinned provenance; product implementation/acceptance are separate records.

body.value: Владеет единым import hook, form controller, pin версии в Bundle/draft, debounce/stale guards, warning/block и before-save gate. Native GIS/формат принадлежит maplib; не дублировать интерпретатор и host functions в UI.

review.value: One import/controller/pinned-version/stale/debounce/warning/Save owner; native interpreter/host APIs stay in maplib.

authority_limit.value: Path applicability is reviewed separately from the rule's textual triggers. Every source condition and heading remains attached; no automatic predicate or lifecycle inference. Stored commands and dates do not grant current execution, freshness or product acceptance. Existing instruction clients/checkers remain effective until measured cutover.
